name: Joao Paulo de Oliveira
text:
We had our new home inspected by Jardan from MF, and the service was excellent from start to finish. He was extremely thorough, professional, and knowledgeable, spotting all details. Jardan explained everything clearly and was very friendly and easy to deal with.

A special mention to Wanessa, who was always available on WhatsApp and very flexible whenever we needed to adjust anything.

The final report was detailed, well-organized, and delivered quickly. We highly recommend MF project solutions for anyone needing a reliable snagging inspection!
highlight: The final report was detailed, well-organized, and delivered quickly.
